Jakob Burcharth is a department physician (*afdelingslæge*) affiliated with Herlev and Gentofte Hospital in the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*) [^src1]. He represents the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition (*Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring*) [^src1]. 

Burcharth serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] [^src1]. His inclusion in this governing body ensures that specialized nutritional expertise is integrated into the quality measurement and evaluation of surgical patient pathways within the database [^src1]. The steering committee reflects an interdisciplinary and cross-regional governance structure, overseeing the clinical quality development of acute surgery under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1].
